stories.title: Wild-meat consumption estimated across Central Africa
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 30 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01306-0A regional analysis brought together data on wild-animal consumption by more than 12,000 households, to investigate trends and drivers of wild-meat use across Central Africa. The study found that consumption has increased over the past two decades, and that the increase was driven by demand from growing towns and cities.
